note: P4 golden frame #0 — domHash of the FULL harbor-dusk frame at t=0 (re-baked from P3 ocean-only: P4 adds the projected sky dome + the 2nd gradient (sky.top→sky.horizon), the 3 haze-mixed mountain ranges with interior strokes, and the city of backface-culled prism buildings + landmark spire; background is now the flat sky.top zenith fill). 426 SVG nodes, exactly 2 gradients (§8.4). domHash is platform-independent (engine+renderer output only), so it carries no platform tag.
